guidanceSections.title: Prepare · Adamah
guidanceSections.body: Bring single-target physical attacks and Fire, Ice, Wind and Light/Dark coverage. Carry SP recovery and ailment cures; the late consecutive fights punish arriving depleted. The Judgment milestones, rescues and final Monad task above/below remain separate objectives.

guidanceSections.title: 230F · Obsessive Sand
guidanceSections.body: No elemental weakness; all attack elements are resisted. Use physical damage, buffs and defense debuffs. Poison is an optional source of damage if it lands.

guidanceSections.title: 236F · Castle and Soldiers
guidanceSections.body: Use Fire on Foot Soldiers and Pierce on Mage Soldiers, targeting separately to avoid reflected attacks. Comeback Castle reflects Slash and can summon replacements: reduce its HP while controlling the supporting enemies.

guidanceSections.title: 241F · Overseers of Creation
guidanceSections.body: Both reflect Light/Dark and have no elemental weakness. Use physical, other elemental damage or Theurgy with attack-down and defense-up support.

guidanceSections.title: 246F / 247F · Consecutive guards
guidanceSections.body: Use Ice on Appropriating Noble and Strike on Invasive Serpents. The Noble drains SP; cure Poison and keep recovery items. At 247F, High Judge of Hell blocks Strike/Ice/Wind and resists Slash/Pierce: Fire, Electricity and Theurgy are useful damage choices.

guidanceSections.title: 253F / 254F / 255F · Final guards
guidanceSections.body: Use Wind on Cultist of Death. Hedonistic Sinners reflect Slash/Pierce, block Fire and drain Electricity: use Strike, Ice or Wind. Genocidal Mercenary reflects Strike/Electricity/Dark and drains Ice: use Pierce, Fire or Wind. Keep Confusion cures ready and heal through the consecutive sequence.

steps.label: Continue through Adamah: Judgment reaches ranks 2–10 at 227F, 230F, 236F, 241F, 246F, 247F, 253F, 254F, and 255F respectively
steps.tip: Judgment progression follows the floors you actually reach: ranks 2–10 correspond to 227F, 230F, 236F, 241F, 246F, 247F, 253F, 254F and 255F, in that order. January 15 is this route's planned climb, not a date that grants all those ranks automatically. If you stop early, leave this combined task unfinished until you have reached the final milestone.

guidanceSections.title: Prepare · Final Monad Passage
guidanceSections.body: Heal and restore SP before the passage. Keep burst damage and a charged Theurgy for Shadow of the Void. This party battle for Request #99 is separate from the later solo ultimate-adversary request.

guidanceSections.title: Fight · Shadow of the Void
guidanceSections.body: It regenerates 300 HP each turn and can fully heal with Diarahan around half health. Keep consistent damage, then hold enough burst to finish after that heal. Guard after Charge before Akasha Arts and after Concentrate before Megidolaon. Report the victory separately as the task above instructs.

guidanceSections.title: Prepare · Reaper
guidanceSections.body: Save first and restore the party. On an ordinary Tartarus floor, wait until Fuuka warns about the Reaper, then approach it prepared. Bring strong healing, revival items, debuffs and protection against instant kills; there is no elemental weakness to exploit.

guidanceSections.title: Fight · Reaper
guidanceSections.body: Keep its attack lowered and party defense raised, heal before spending HP on physical skills, and use your strongest safe attacks/Theurgies. Its multiple actions can punish exposed weaknesses. If survival is unreliable, return after improving your party rather than treating an attempt as victory.

guidanceSections.title: Optional · Armageddon
guidanceSections.body: If Helel and Satan are both registered and Armageddon is unlocked, fill the protagonist's Theurgy gauge before engaging. Armageddon can defeat the Reaper; its HP/SP cost requires immediate recovery afterward. A prepared ordinary-party strategy is also valid. Keep the Bloody Button for the separate Elizabeth hand-in.

guidanceSections.title: Prepare · Promised Day
guidanceSections.body: Save and recover before the ascent. Bring party healing, SP recovery, revival and Fear/Charm cures, plus protection from Light/Dark instant kills. Keep varied physical and elemental options; the finale has multiple phases that one early Armageddon cannot skip.

guidanceSections.title: 259F · Jin
guidanceSections.body: Jin repels Fire/Dark and exploits exposed party weaknesses. Use other damage while maintaining buffs/debuffs. His late Potent Stim Injection restores him and powers up his attacks; recover and guard when needed while his own HP loss helps end that phase.

guidanceSections.title: 263F · Takaya
guidanceSections.body: Avoid reflected Light and drained Dark. Keep SP recovery and Fear cures available. After his late party-wide drain/Fear attack, cure Fear before Ghastly Wail and restore healing capacity. Save some charged Theurgy damage for this phase.

guidanceSections.title: 264F · Nyx Avatar
guidanceSections.body: Nyx has 14 Arcana forms with changing resistances. Recheck after every Arcana Shift; do not repeat an attack into Null, Repel or Drain. Physical damage suits magic-resistant forms; magic suits physical-resistant forms. Cure Fear/Charm promptly and preserve recovery items for Death.

guidanceSections.title: Final form · Death
guidanceSections.body: Heal the party immediately after Apocalypse takes almost all current HP. Keep healing and ailment cures ready for Night Queen, then use safe burst damage and saved Theurgies. A charged Armageddon is an optional finish in Death, not a way to skip every earlier form. Continue the story and use Great Seal when prompted.
